title.narrative: Contribution to universal access of DR Congo populations to effective interventions to fight malaria and Extension of Interventions Against Malaria in 219 Health Zones - Congo (Democratic Republic) (01-Jan-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Congo (Democratic Republic), Malaria, SANRU Asbl (SANRU)This program has the following goals: Contribute to the improvement of health status of the population of DRC by reducing human and socio-economic burden caused by malaria. The objectives of this program are: Bring at least 80% of people at risk of malaria to sleep under an LLIN. Confirm at least 80% of suspected malaria cases seen in the public health facilities and in the community by microscopy or RDTs in 308 targeted HZs Confirm at least 80% of suspected malaria cases seen in the public health facilities and in the community b. Cover at least 80% of pregnant women attending ANC with IPTp according to national guidelines in targeted 308 HZs. Treat all confirmed malaria cases according to national guidelines in public health facilities and community in 308 targeted HZs
